text:
emma: Hey — AtlasHealth POC wrapping up. Need to offboard their environment this week: Hosted API keys, dedicated pool dp-879, and the VPC private endpoint. Who can own each step? Also client asked about prorated billing for Dedicated hours.

jordan: I can take hosted API keys. Plan: rotate any active keys and then revoke the test key. Will post exact curl. ETA today.

jordan: Revocation command (will redact actual key here):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/revoke \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"key":"sk-REDACTED"}'
```

miguel: On Dedicated dp-879: recommend drain connections, snapshot KV cache (if they want warm start later), then schedule teardown outside business hours. I can drain/teardown but need a 2-hour window. Any preferred day?

emma: Client prefers Thu evening UTC. Can we do Thu 23:00 UTC?

miguel: Thu 23:00 UTC works. I'll set drain at 23:00, teardown at 23:30. Will post pool-id and steps once scheduled.

ops-bot: [automated] Pool dp-879 scheduled for drain at 2026-03-26T23:00:00Z by miguel.

alex: Security notes:
- VPC private endpoint removal requires confirmation of any peering routes removed on their side.
- KMS key for POC data: if they want immediate crypto key deletion, KMS imposes a 7-day pending window before irreversible deletion (depends on their KMS settings).
- Audit logs: default retention is 90 days; legal may require 180 for HIPAA. We need AtlasHealth to sign off on retention window.

emma: AtlasHealth legal replied: 90 days accepted. They asked for confirmation that we will revoke hosted keys and scrub logs from the POC bucket (not production) after retention window.

alex: For \"scrub logs\" we can delete S3 objects under the POC prefix after retention. Note that backups/snapshots must also be considered. I'll coordinate with miguel on snapshot lifecycles.

jordan: Billing: I confirmed we prorate Dedicated on daily basis — they'll only pay for hours used up to teardown. I'll send the invoice estimate after teardown.

miguel: Checklist I will follow before teardown:
1) Drain connections -> verify zero active sessions
2) Snapshot KV cache -> store for 7 days if requested
3) Revoke pool service credentials
4) Delete pool resources and detach volumes
5) Confirm S3/persistent logs deletion per retention
6) Update ticket + confirm with client

emma: Perfect. Action items: jordan revoke hosted keys (emma to verify), miguel drain+teardown Thu 23:00 UTC, alex confirm KMS/routing cleanup, jordan handle invoice. Please react with :thumbsup: when done.

jordan: Starting key rotation now.

miguel: I'll post a brief post-teardown summary after 23:30 UTC.

alex: Will validate KMS deletion window and post any legal constraints.

ops-bot: [automated] Ticket #POC-452 marked \"scheduled for teardown\".

emma: Thanks all — will ping client once we have teardown completed and invoice estimate.
